description: This file provides utility functions for styling UI components such as cards, overlays, and focus rings, utilizing a theming system.

methods.name: cardStyle({ w = 420, h = 280, radius = theme.radii.lg } = {})
methods.description: Generates style object for a card with customizable width, height, radius, and surface color.

methods.name: gradientOverlay({ w, h, alpha = 0.12 })
methods.description: Creates a semi-transparent overlay style with optional alpha transparency.

methods.name: focusRing({ w, h, radius = theme.radii.md, show = false })
methods.description: Creates style object for focus ring with adjustable size, radius, and visibility.
